request: The data management team has not finished the export for this project, and I cannot infer the number of measured features from its working filename. There are two plausible releases: a compact targeted panel and a large untargeted panel. Both releases have the same participants and would otherwise satisfy the paired-table requirements. Our funding milestone requires retaining every pair of features and every participant in a single run. Reducing the panel, dropping people, or splitting the requested output into multiple independent runs has not been approved. I need a capability judgment that waits for the size fact rather than assuming the smaller release. Can LIONESS-DRAGON process all feature pairs for our 100 participants? There are either 100 or 1000 total features across the two layers; the export manifest has not arrived.
